objective: Provide a reusable platform capability for secure persistent files up to 5GB with resumable transfer, integrity checks, malware isolation, preview and ranged download.
users: Operators monitoring storage, scanning and cleanup

requirements.statement: Upload files up to 5GB through resumable multipart sessions with per-user concurrency and storage quota enforcement.
acceptance: Parts can be retried without restarting successful parts
Expired or cancelled sessions clean unfinished parts idempotently
A user cannot exceed 20 concurrent uploads
counterexample: Buffering a complete 5GB file in application memory
Trusting the client to declare a completed upload

requirements.statement: Compute server-side MD5 and SHA-256 and isolate every object until ClamAV reports it clean.
acceptance: Stored hashes match the completed object
A test malware file enters quarantine
Non-ready files cannot be previewed, downloaded or business-bound
counterexample: Using multipart ETag as the file MD5
Allowing scan failure to bypass quarantine

requirements.statement: Expose business-neutral attachment contracts for controlled preview, HTTP Range download and physical cleanup without leaking object keys.
acceptance: Business modules persist attachment IDs only
Preview and download enforce tenant and access policy
counterexample: A business page constructs MinIO or kkFileView URLs
The platform attachment module imports a business implementation

invariants: Business modules never own object keys
The platform module does not depend on data-migration implementation

selected_approach.name: Dedicated ccb-attachment platform module
selected_approach.reason: Storage, scanning and preview are reusable platform concerns while business ownership remains outside the platform.

alternatives.name: Implement storage inside data migration
alternatives.rejected_because: It duplicates security-critical infrastructure for every business module.

alternatives.name: Extend temporary file preview directly
alternatives.rejected_because: The current preview service deliberately has no persistent metadata or long-term lifecycle.

components.name: Upload session service
components.responsibility: Authorize, sign and finalize multipart uploads

components.name: File inspection pipeline
components.responsibility: Stream hashes, inspect type and invoke ClamAV

components.name: Attachment access gateway
components.responsibility: Authorize preview/download through registered business policies

interfaces.name: Multipart upload API
interfaces.contract: Create, sign, inspect, complete or cancel a scoped session

interfaces.name: Attachment Java API
interfaces.contract: Resolve READY attachment metadata and request controlled access or cleanup

interfaces.name: AttachmentAccessPolicy SPI
interfaces.contract: Decide access for an opaque business binding without a platform-to-business dependency

data_flows.output: Persistent attachment UUID and immutable technical metadata

error_handling.behavior: Preserve successful parts and expose retry state
error_handling.recovery: Retry the failed part before session expiry

error_handling.behavior: Keep the object inaccessible in SCAN_FAILED
error_handling.recovery: Retry scanning without re-uploading the object

error_handling.behavior: Set QUARANTINED and deny all content access
error_handling.recovery: A security administrator applies an audited quarantine action

error_handling.behavior: Retain metadata and a retryable deletion state

verification_strategy.signal: Multipart state and resulting object for success, pause, retry, cancel and expiry
verification_strategy.method: MinIO integration tests and equivalent large-file streaming tests
Hash fixtures, MIME spoofing tests and a synthetic antivirus test file

verification_strategy.signal: Authorized preview/range download and denied cross-tenant access
verification_strategy.method: API, SPI contract and security integration tests

assumptions.text: MinIO, ClamAV and kkFileView can run as controlled local or deployment services
assumptions.basis: User selected the built-in scanning and existing preview approach
assumptions.falsifier: The target deployment prohibits one of these services

unknowns.question: Will this requirement supersede or amend the unimplemented attachment scope in REQ-20260814-022?
unknowns.impact: Blocks ready status to prevent parallel platform attachment implementations

decisions.decision: Use resumable multipart upload for files up to 5GB
decisions.reason: Large migration assets cannot rely on a single Spring multipart request
Preview and external delivery must not process unscanned files

risks.risk: Large transfers and scanning exhaust application or storage resources
risks.mitigation: Streaming IO, quotas, concurrency bounds, timeouts and observable asynchronous states

risks.risk: Overlap with REQ-20260814-022 creates two attachment contracts
risks.mitigation: Owner must choose one merged contract before ready status

approval.evidence: User confirmed all seven design sections and selected the dedicated-module approach.
